question: Given a Seurat object with broad cell type annotations, perform sub-clustering analysis on the T-cell population to investigate T-cell subtypes (e.g., CD4+, CD8+, regulatory T-cells). Find the top marker genes per sub-cluster and save a UMAP plot with cells colored by sub-cluster.

expected_output.description: UMAP 1 as x-axis, UMAP 2 as y-axis, points colored and labeled by T-cell subcluster
rows as marker genes, columns should include gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj
